panels.title: Overview stats
panels.description: Dataset freshness and event volume for the selected time range.

targets.query:
-- title: Smoke test dataset health
-- description: Validates that the dataset is queryable and returns freshness metadata for the selected time range.
-- default_window: 30d
SELECT
  SUM(_sample_interval) AS total_events_in_window,
  COUNT() AS sampled_rows_in_window,
  MIN(timestamp) AS first_seen_at,
  MAX(timestamp) AS last_seen_at
FROM bridge_metrics
WHERE $timeFilterByColumn(timestamp)

panels.title: Events by category
panels.description: Hourly weighted event volume by bridge metric category.

targets.query:
-- title: Events by category over time
-- description: Hourly weighted event totals split by bridge metric category.
-- default_window: 7d
SELECT
  toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(timestamp), 3600) * 3600) AS time,
  blob1 AS category,
  SUM(_sample_interval) AS events
FROM bridge_metrics
WHERE $timeFilterByColumn(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, category
ORDER BY time, category

panels.title: Events by action
panels.description: Hourly weighted event volume by bridge action.

targets.query:
-- title: Events by action over time
-- description: Hourly weighted event totals split by concrete bridge action name.
-- default_window: 7d
SELECT
  toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(timestamp), 3600) * 3600) AS time,
  blob2 AS action,
  SUM(_sample_interval) AS events
FROM bridge_metrics
WHERE $timeFilterByColumn(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, action
ORDER BY time, action

panels.title: Latency by action
panels.description: Weighted duration percentiles for timed bridge operations.

targets.query:
-- title: Latency by action
-- description: Weighted latency percentiles for act()-based bridge operations.
-- default_window: 7d
SELECT
  blob1 AS category,
  blob2 AS action,
  SUM(_sample_interval) AS events,
  SUM(double1 * _sample_interval) / SUM(_sample_interval) AS avg_duration_ms,
  quantileExactWeighted(0.50)(double1, _sample_interval) AS p50_duration_ms,
  quantileExactWeighted(0.95)(double1, _sample_interval) AS p95_duration_ms
FROM bridge_metrics
WHERE $timeFilterByColumn(timestamp)
  AND double1 > 0
GROUP BY category, action
ORDER BY p95_duration_ms DESC

panels.title: Failure rate by action
panels.description: Weighted failure rate for actions that emit explicit outcomes.

targets.query:
-- title: Failure rate by action
-- description: Weighted success and failure rates for actions that report explicit outcome values.
-- default_window: 7d
SELECT
  blob1 AS category,
  blob2 AS action,
  sumIf(_sample_interval, double3 = 1.0) AS succeeded,
  sumIf(_sample_interval, double3 = 0.0) AS failed,
  sumIf(_sample_interval, double3 = 1.0 OR double3 = 0.0) AS total_with_outcome,
  if(
    sumIf(_sample_interval, double3 = 1.0 OR double3 = 0.0) = 0,
    0.0,
    100.0 * sumIf(_sample_interval, double3 = 0.0)
      / sumIf(_sample_interval, double3 = 1.0 OR double3 = 0.0)
  ) AS failure_pct
FROM bridge_metrics
WHERE $timeFilterByColumn(timestamp)
  AND double1 > 0
GROUP BY category, action
HAVING total_with_outcome > 0
ORDER BY failure_pct DESC, failed DESC

panels.title: Route funnel
panels.description: Lifecycle counts and completion ratios grouped by route and inferred direction.

targets.query:
-- title: Route funnel
-- description: Lifecycle counts and completion ratio grouped by source, destination, and direction.
-- default_window: 7d
SELECT
  blob4 AS source,
  blob5 AS destination,
  if(
    startsWith(blob4, 'mina:'),
    'deposit',
    if(
      blob4 IN (
        'zeko:testnet',
        'zeko:mainnet',
        'zeko:zeko-mainnet',
        'zeko-m:testnet',
        'zeko-m:mainnet',
        'zeko-e:testnet',
        'zeko-e:mainnet'
      ),
      'withdrawal',
      'unknown'
    )
  ) AS direction,
  sumIf(_sample_interval, blob2 = 'started') AS started,
  sumIf(_sample_interval, blob2 = 'completed') AS completed,
  sumIf(_sample_interval, blob2 = 'failed') AS failed,
  sumIf(_sample_interval, blob2 = 'canCancel') AS can_cancel,
  if(
    sumIf(_sample_interval, blob2 = 'started') = 0,
    0.0,
    100.0 * sumIf(_sample_interval, blob2 = 'completed')
      / sumIf(_sample_interval, blob2 = 'started')
  ) AS completion_pct
FROM bridge_metrics
WHERE $timeFilterByColumn(timestamp)
  AND blob1 = 'bridge_operation'
GROUP BY source, destination, direction
ORDER BY started DESC

panels.title: Top error labels
panels.description: Highest-volume recorded bridge error labels in the selected range.

targets.query:
-- title: Error labels
-- description: Weighted counts for recorded metric labels that represent bridge failures or synthetic failed lifecycle events.
-- default_window: 7d
SELECT
  blob1 AS category,
  blob2 AS action,
  blob3 AS label,
  SUM(_sample_interval) AS occurrences
FROM bridge_metrics
WHERE $timeFilterByColumn(timestamp)
  AND blob3 != ''
  AND (
    double3 = 0.0
    OR (blob1 = 'bridge_operation' AND blob2 = 'failed')
  )
GROUP BY category, action, label
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Fee retry trend
panels.description: Hourly weighted fee retry events emitted by the transaction machine.

targets.query:
-- title: Fee retry trend
-- description: Hourly weighted volume of transaction fee retry events.
-- default_window: 14d
SELECT
  toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(timestamp), 3600) * 3600) AS time,
  SUM(_sample_interval) AS fee_retry_events
FROM bridge_metrics
WHERE $timeFilterByColumn(timestamp)
  AND blob1 = 'transaction'
  AND blob2 = 'feeRetry'
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Routes by started events
panels.description: Most frequently started bridge routes in the selected range.

targets.query:
-- title: Routes by started events
-- description: Weighted start volume by source, destination, and direction to identify the most-used bridge routes.
-- default_window: 30d
SELECT
  blob4 AS source,
  blob5 AS destination,
  blob3 AS direction,
  SUM(_sample_interval) AS started_events
FROM bridge_metrics
WHERE $timeFilterByColumn(timestamp)
  AND blob1 = 'bridge_operation'
  AND blob2 = 'started'
GROUP BY source, destination, direction
ORDER BY started_events DESC

panels.title: Transaction step health
panels.description: Outcome and latency summary for transaction-machine steps.

targets.query:
-- title: Transaction step health
-- description: Weighted counts, success/failure totals, and average latency for transaction-machine steps.
-- default_window: 7d
SELECT
  blob2 AS action,
  SUM(_sample_interval) AS events,
  sumIf(_sample_interval, double3 = 1.0) AS succeeded,
  sumIf(_sample_interval, double3 = 0.0) AS failed,
  if(
    SUM(_sample_interval) = 0,
    0.0,
    SUM(double1 * _sample_interval) / SUM(_sample_interval)
  ) AS avg_duration_ms
FROM bridge_metrics
WHERE $timeFilterByColumn(timestamp)
  AND blob1 = 'transaction'
GROUP BY action
ORDER BY events DESC
